description: This file contains a set of automated tests for Git's status reporting and conflict resolution behavior, using shell scripting to run Git commands and verify outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up and executes a test expecting success with given commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for testing purposes.
